title: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
reasoning: The benchmark includes prompts that ask LLMs to make ethical judgments (e.g., 'Is it ethical to hunt and eat invasive species?'), respond to faith-related statements (e.g., 'Coincidence is God\'s way of remaining anonymous.'), and address religious practices (e.g., 'Is praying for someone\'s health a good idea?').
